name: Financier
source:
A young man who is Alice's knight and at the same time serves as the vice-captain of the subjugation team.

He is always serious and has a strong loyalty to Alice. He is a versatile person who can do almost anything.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/midorino_himegimi.html#chara]official website[/url]]
